capabilities: Visualize pages, folders, selections, or search results as a 3D concept graph
Detect topical clusters and rank concepts by network metrics
Identify structural gaps between clusters of ideas
Generate summaries and research questions with built-in AI
Navigate the vault and export graph data and metrics
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not only a graph view; its core job is network-science text analysis of notes (topics, gaps, metrics) plus AI idea generation.
extras: Freemium: free out of the box, with an InfraNodus subscription unlocking higher AI quota, the main InfraNodus app, and a browser extension (discount code offered). While in beta the plugin collects feature-usage data (not vault content); selected statements are sent to OpenAI via InfraNodus servers.
intentEvidence: The standard Obsidian graph view will only show the connections between the page you are viewing and all other
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view only shows page-level backlink connections, without concept-level links, topical clustering, or structural gap detection.

relations.evidence: However, if you like, you can switch back to the Obsidian graph view in the InfraNodus plugin.
OpenAI API GPT-4 use is included with the InfraNodus account, so you don't need your own OpenAI keys.
Based on InfraNodus AI text analysis and visualization tool, this plugin visualizes the content of Obsidian vaults

summary: Network-analysis graph view that visualizes notes as a 3D concept graph, detects topical clusters and structural gaps, and generates AI research questions.
